title: Deploy and exercise the zero-idle thin turn
description:
Deploy the thin turn through CDK and prove it end to end.

Acceptance criteria:
- A browser or test client posts one message and observes progress and completion.
- A forced disconnect demonstrates replay from committed state.
- A stopped computer remains stopped for the entire turn.
- No persistent socket, always-on scheduler, API process, lock service, or database is introduced.
- Logs identify tenant_id, channel_id, turn_id, and attempt_id without recording message content or secrets.
- The executable specifications and Python quality gates pass.

comments.author: home
comments.text: Implementing ChatticusThinTurn: Lambda Web Adapter front door, DynamoDB, SQS computerless worker, CloudFront, no ALB. SSE will poll the store so it survives separate Lambda invocations. Spike stack will not be redeployed.
